vopros: Who in the US can check what AI assistants say about my company?

vyzhimka.tekst:
Anyone in the US (or anywhere else, really) can check this — you don't need special access or credentials, since these are consumer AI tools. Here's how:

## Do‑It‑Yourself (free, takes minutes)
Just open ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Perplexity yourself and ask about your business directly. Specific guidance from search results:

- Ask ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity "What is [your business name] in [your town]?" using a fresh chat with no prior context, since an assistant that has seen your website earlier in the conversation will simply repeat it back
- Perplexity cites sources directly, and ChatGPT and Gemini often will if asked, so you can follow those links to find out where the answer came from — often it's an outdated directory listing rather than your own site that you have never updated rather than from your own website.
- Note that a single check tells you nothing, because answers vary between runs — the value is in the comparison over time.

## Free online checker tools
Several sites let you type in a company name and get an instant report:
- **AI Mentions** – lets you find out if AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity recommend your company, as a free AI visibility checker for businesses.
- **MarketBetter** – lets you check what AI models say about your brand, completely free.

## Paid monitoring platforms (ongoing tracking)
If you want continuous monitoring rather than one-off checks, US-based and international SaaS platforms include:
- **Otterly.ai** – tracks brand visibility across ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews, starting at ~$29/month
- **SE Ranking (ChatGPT Visibility Tracker)** – ChatGPT visibility tracking integrated with their SEO platform, with plans from $65/month
- **Profound** – an AI search optimization platform with real-time visibility monitoring, at enterprise pricing
- **Meltwater (GenAI Lens)** – runs searches on the platform and creates a database of responses, since there's no way to pull brand mentions directly from ChatGPT queries
- **Scrunch AI** – focuses on brand safety, detecting when ChatGPT says incorrect things about your brand, with an Agent Experience Platform that creates machine-readable versions of your brand for AI crawlers
- Other options mentioned include Frase AI Visibility, GenRank, AIclicks, Talkwalker's LLM Insights, GrowByData, and LLM Pulse, each tracking mentions, sentiment, and competitor comparisons across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Claude.

## Bottom line
In practice, **anyone** — you, a marketing agency, or a third-party monitoring service — can check this, because unlike traditional SEO where you can track rankings and clicks, AI recommendations happen in private conversations, so there's no analytics dashboard showing mentions, and the only way to know what AI says about you is to ask it directly. There's no gatekeeper or special US-specific authority — it's an open question you can investigate yourself or outsource to a growing industry of "AI visibility" agencies and tools.
